resumos: A JavaScript library for parsing and stringifying JSON5, which can be used for flexible frontmatter.
Superset of JSON with relaxed syntax rules, supporting comments and unquoted keys.
JSON superset with optional trailing commas, comments, and unquoted keys—useful for structured frontmatter in Markdown.
Uma extensão do JSON que permite comentários e chaves não citadas, facilitando a leitura e escrita de arquivos JSON.
